subject: general
question:
The value of

(1 + cot² θ)(1 + cos θ) (1 - cos θ) - (1 - sin θ)(1 + sin θ)(1 + tan² θ) is: (θ lies in first quadrant)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put **θ = 45°** since the expression is independent of θ.

⇒ (1 + cot² 45°)(1 + cos 45°)(1 − cos 45°) − (1 − sin 45°)(1 + sin 45°)(1 + tan² 45°)

⇒ (1 + 1)(1 − cos² 45°) − (1 − sin² 45°)(1 + 1)

⇒ 2 × (1 − 1/2) − (1 − 1/2) × 2 = (2 × 1/2) − (1/2 × 2) = 1 − 1 = 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (1 + cot² θ)(1 + cos θ)(1 − cos θ) − (1 − sin θ)(1 + sin θ)(1 + tan² θ)

**Formulas Used:** 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ | 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ | (a − b)(a + b) = a² − b²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4eaf3e5c5b54effb13ac8e0034a4c92a8d97f72158aaee6141ee5bef11d8791.png] 

⇒ (1 + cot² θ)(1 − cos² θ) − (1 − sin² θ)(1 + tan² θ)

⇒ (cosec² θ)(sin² θ) − (cos² θ)(sec² θ)

⇒ (1/sin² θ × sin² θ) − (cos² θ × 1/cos² θ)

⇒ 1 − 1 = 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Standard identities: sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ, and 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ.

Reciprocal Relations

sin θ × cosec θ = 1, cos θ × sec θ = 1, and tan θ × cot θ = 1.</p
